author: FunForLouis
description:
I’ve been having so much fun capturing life out here in Costa Rica on the @antigravity_global A1 360 drone 

Flying over rivers, through the forest canopy, along the beach, spotting scarlet macaws, and exploring our eco village

It shoots in full 360, so I can fly once and choose any angle later. And flying FPV with the goggles makes the whole experience feel really immersive and natural.

Such a fun way to explore and document this chapter of life.

title: Exploring Costa Rica with Antigravity A1 360 Drone
